players.bio: Adrián Guillermo Sánchez (born 14 May 1999) is an Argentine footballer playing as a midfielder for Atlético Tucumán. Career A product of Boca Juniors, Sánchez was loaned out to Uruguayan club Cerro Largo in 2020 and the Chilean club Curicó Unido and Everton in 2021 and 2022, respectively. In 2023, he was loaned out to Atlético Tucumán.
Adrián Marcelo Spörle (born 13 July 1995) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left midfielder for Independiente.

Alexis Maldonado (born 2 September 1997 in La Rioja, La Rioja) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defender for Belgrano in the Argentine Professional League. Career Banfield In 2013, Maldonado took a test, being seen by Banfield coordinators.
Emiliano Ariel Rigoni (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 4 February 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Brazilian Série A club São Paulo.

Facundo Tomás Quignón (born 2 May 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Club Atlético Belgrano. Club career In June 2021, Quignón signed with FC Dallas on a two-and-a-half-year contract. On April 23, 2022, Quignón scored his first MLS goal, against Houston Dynamo FC in a 2–1 FC Dallas win.
Federico Ricca Rostagnol (born 1 December 1994) is a Uruguayan footballer who plays as a left-back for Belgian side OH Leuven. He can also play as a centre-back.
Francisco González Metilli (born 29 March 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Belgrano.

Franco Damián Vázquez (born 22 February 1989) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Serie A club Cremonese. Vázquez began his career with Argentine club Belgrano in 2007, before moving to Italian side Palermo in 2011.
Sandro Leonardo Morales (born 11 April 1991) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or right-back for Club de Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata.
Lisandro Ezequiel López (born 1 September 1989) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defender for Spanish club Burgos CF. He has also appeared for the Argentina national team.

Lucas Giuliano Passerini (born 16 July 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Belgrano. Career Passerini got underway with Quilmes in 2014. His debut appearance for Quilmes arrived on 8 August 2014, he played fourteen minutes of a Primera División match with Rosario Central; which was one of two appearances he made for the club.

Lucas Manuel Zelarayán (Armenian: Լուկաս Մանուել Զելարայան; born 20 June 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al-Fateh. Born in Argentina, he represents the Armenia national team. He began his professional career with Belgrano in the Argentine Primera División in 2012, moving in 2016 to Tigres UANL in the Liga MX.
Matías Ezequiel Suárez (born 9 May 1988) is an Argentine footballer who plays for River Plate as a forward.
Nicolás Emanuel "Uvita" Fernández (born 8 February 1996), is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Belgrano.
Pablo Chavarría (born 2 January 1988) is an Argentine footballer who plays for Spanish club RCD Mallorca as a Striker.

Ricardo Alberto Zielinski (born 14 October 1959) is an Argentine football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He is the current manager of Belgrano. Career "El Ruso" started his playing career at San Telmo in 1979. Zielinski also played for Argentino de Quilmes, Chacarita Juniors, Deportivo Mandiyú, Deportivo Laferrere and Ituzaingó.

Thiago Gastón Cardozo Brugman (born 31 July 1996) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Belgrano, on loan from Unión Santa Fe. Club career A youth academy graduate of Peñarol, Cardozo made his professional debut on 5 May 2018 in a 4–1 league win against Defensor Sporting. In April 2021, he joined Deportivo Maldonado on a season long loan deal.
